page.overview:
Who is Amanda Sharpe?

Amanda Sharpe, the Student, is a character created by Fantasy Flight Games for their Arkham Horror Cthulhu Mythos setting.

A 2-year student at Arkham's prestigious Miskatonic University during the late 1920s, Amanda has been having nightmares of an ancient entity sleeping beneath the waves. These dreams were sparked by the sight of a painting hanging in the university’s halls, and have had a negative impact on her schoolwork.

In Graham McNeill's novel Ghouls of the Miskatonic, Amanda and her friend and roommate Rita Young were kidnapped by a cult of Cthulhu worshippers who intended to feed the pair to their pet ghouls. Fortunately, the two were saved by an unlikely band of heroes, including Rex Murphy and Finn Edwards.

First introduced in Fantasy Flight's Arkham Horror Second Edition Core Set, Amanda Sharpe has since appeared in several other of the company's releases, including Eldritch Horror and Arkham Horror: The Card Game, and a plastic model of Amanda was created for the Arkham Horror Premium Figures series. Her character was expanded on significantly in Graham McNeill's novel Ghouls of the Miskatonic, and she was included as a playable investigator character in Jonathan Green's 2024 gamebook The Darkness Over Arkham.
